test_forged_admin_headers_are_rejected_b: An attacker may be able to impersonate an administrator.
Require verified credentials at each service boundary.
test_missing_identity_is_rejected: Requests without an identity must be denied.
test_anonymous_socket_is_rejected: Protect live updates from anonymous visitors
Visitors without a login may receive hospital activity updates.
Require authentication before accepting live-update connections.
test_first_login_restricted_socket_is_re: Require password setup before live updates
An account awaiting password setup may receive hospital updates.
Block restricted accounts until password setup is complete.
test_expired_jwt_is_rejected_before_redi: Expired credentials must not grant access.
Validate credential expiration before granting access.
test_old_cleaning_completion_cannot_free: An old cleaning action may incorrectly free an occupied bed.
Reject outdated cleaning actions and verify the current bed allocation.
test_old_equipment_release_cannot_free_r: Protect equipment already assigned to someone else
An old release action may incorrectly make assigned equipment available.
Validate the current equipment assignment before changing availability.
test_housekeeping_grid_hides_patient_det: Limit housekeeping access to patient details
Housekeeping may receive patient identifiers and diagnoses.
Return only the information approved for housekeeping duties.
test_auth_requests_are_not_idempotency_c: Prevent reuse of saved login responses
A saved response may return another request's login credentials.
Exclude login and recovery responses from shared request caching.
test_revocation_failure_is_not_reported_: The app may claim access ended even when session revocation failed.
Confirm access was revoked or record a durable recovery action.
test_audit_storage_failure_is_not_silent: Report failures when saving access history
The app may hide a failure to save the audit history.
Make audit failures visible and preserve events reliably.
test_existing_patient_read_produces_audi: Record when patient records are viewed
Patient records may be viewed without an access-history entry.
Record the user, patient record, time and outcome for each read.
test_production_startup_does_not_create_: Keep demo accounts out of production
Production startup may create accounts with known demo credentials.
Disable demo account creation in production.
test_unknown_birth_date_is_not_fabricate: An unknown birth date may be replaced with an invented date.
Reject missing birth dates or explicitly preserve them as unknown.
F05: census snapshots do not persist pat: Keep patient names and diagnoses out of browser storage
Patient details may remain saved on a shared computer.
Keep sensitive snapshots out of persistent browser storage.
F05: EMS intake does not persist clinica: Protect ambulance intake details on shared computers
Ambulance patient details may remain saved in the browser.
Store clinical intake through an authorized backend instead.
F23: zero capacity must remain zero in c: The assistant may report available beds when none are available.
Preserve zero capacity and remove invented fallback availability.
